example: "Gölsdorf Series 380 steam locomotive, designed by famed Austrian locomotive designer "

"London & North Eastern Railway's No. 4472 Flying Scotsman steam locomotive, modeled as it was in the 1920s. In"
"Train Simulator, Flying Scotsman typically pulls a consist of luxury passenger cars on the Settle &"
"Carlisle line.\n\n"
"Locomotive type & no.: LNER A1 4-6-2 8P, No. 4472\n\n"
"Power source: 180 psi hand-fired, coal burning boiler\n\n"
"Wheel configuration: Six 80-in. (2.03m) diameter driving wheels in a 4-6-2 configuration\n\n"

"The SD40-2 is a powerful diesel-electric locomotive built in the 1970s and 80s by the "
"Electro-Motive Division of General Motors. This reliable locomotive is used to haul a variety of cargo. "
"Although being replaced by newer locomotives, the BNSF still uses hundreds of SD40-2 locomotives "
"all over the BNSF system.\n\n"
"Locomotive type: Diesel-Electric\n\n"

"To move forward\n"
"1.	Press the W key several times to move the Reverser to full Forward.\n"
"2.	Press the ; (SEMICOLON) key to release the train brakes.\n"
"3.	Press the [ (LEFT BRACKET) key to release the locomotive brake.\n"
"4.	Press the D key to increase the Regulator setting.\n"
"5.	As you accelerate, press the S key to slowly reduce the Reverser setting, then adjust the Regulator to maintain the desired speed.\n\n"
"To slow the train\n"
"1.	Press the A key to move the Regulator to a lower setting.\n"
"2.	Use the brakes to further reduce speed if desired.\n\n"
"To apply the train brakes\n"
"1.	Press the ' (APOSTROPHE) key to apply the train brakes.\n\n"
"To release the train brakes\n"
"To move forward\n"

"2.	Press the W key to move the Reverser to Forward.\n"
"3.	Press the ; (SEMICOLON) key to release the train brakes.\n"
"4.	Press the D key to move increase the throttle setting.\n\n"
"To slow the train\n"
"1.	Press the A key to move the throttle to a lower setting.\n"
"2.	Use the brakes to further reduce speed if desired.\n\n"
"To apply the train brakes\n"
"1.	Press the ' (APOSTROPHE) key to apply the train brakes.\n\n"
"To release the train brakes\n"
"1. Press the ; (SEMICOLON) key to release the train brakes.\n\n"
"To move forward\n"
"1.	Press the W key to move the Reverser to Neutral (if it is not there already) and then to Forward.\n"
"2.	Press the ; (SEMICOLON) key to release the train air brakes.\n"
"3.	Press the [ (LEFT BRACKET) key to release the locomotive brakes.\n"
"4.	Press the D key to move the throttle from Idle to Notch 1 then gradually increase "
"power until your train reaches the desired speed.\n\n"
"To slow the train\n"
"1.	Press the A key to move the throttle to a lower setting.\n"
"2.	Use the train brakes (', the APOSTROPHE key) to further reduce speed if desired.\n\n"
"To apply the train brakes\n"
"1.	Press the ' (APOSTROPHE) key.\n\n"
"To release the train brakes\n"
"To move forward\n"
"1.	Press the W key to move the Reverser to Forward.\n"
"2.	Press the ; (SEMICOLON) key to release the train brakes.\n"
"3.	Press the [ (LEFT BRACKET) key to release the locomotive brake.\n"
"4.	Press the D key to move the throttle from Idle to Notch 1.\n"
"5.	Gradually increase power (D key), one notch at a time, until your train reaches the desired speed.\n\n"
"To slow the train\n"
"1.	Press the A key to move the throttle to a lower setting.\n"
"2.	Use the brakes to further reduce speed if desired.\n\n"
"To apply the dynamic brakes\n"
"1.	Press the A key to move the throttle to the Idle position.\n"

"2.	Wait for 10 seconds, then press the . (PERIOD) key to advance the Dynamic Brake handle from Off to the Setup position.  After allowing a few seconds for braking circuit setup, press the . [PERIOD] key again to set the desired level of dynamic braking (Levels 1 - 8).\n\n"
"To move forward\n"
"1.	Press the W key to move the Reverser to Forward.\n"
"2.	Press the ; (SEMICOLON) key to release the train brakes.\n"
"3.	Press the [ (LEFT BRACKET) key to release the locomotive brake.\n"
"4.	Press the D key to move the throttle from Idle to Notch 1.\n"
"5.	Gradually increase power (D key), one notch at a time, until your train reaches the desired speed.\n\n"
"To slow the train\n"
"1.	Press the A key to move the throttle to a lower setting.\n"
"2.	Use the brakes to further reduce speed if desired.\n\n"
"To apply the dynamic brakes\n"
"1.	Press the A key to move the throttle to the Idle position.\n"

"2.	Wait for 10 seconds, then press the . (PERIOD) key to advance the Dynamic Brake handle from Off to the Setup position. After allowing a few seconds for braking circuit setup, press the . (PERIOD) key again to set the desired level of dynamic braking (Levels 1 - 8).\n\n"
"To move forward\n"
"1. The pantograph has been raised for you. (If it is not up for some reason, press the P key to raise it.)\n"
"2.	Press the W key to move the Reverser to Forward.\n"
"3.	Press the ; (SEMICOLON) key to release the train brakes.\n"
"4. 	Press the [ (LEFT BRACKET) key to release the locomotive brake.\n"
"5.	Press the D key to move increase the Throttle setting.\n\n"
"To slow the train\n"
"1.	Press the A key to move the throttle to a lower setting.\n"
"2.	Use the brakes to further reduce speed if desired.\n\n"
"To apply the train brakes\n"
"1.	Press the ' (APOSTROPHE) key to apply the train brakes.\n\n"
"To release the train brakes\n"
"To move forward\n"
"1.	Press Shift+E if necessary to move the Speed Gear handle to neutral.\n"
"2. Hold down the A key as necessary to move the Throttle to 0%.\n"
"3.	Press the W key to move the Reverser to Forward.\n"
"4. Press E to move the Speed Gear handle to 1.\n"
"5.	Hold down the ; (SEMICOLON) key to release the train brakes.\n"
"6.	Press the D key to move increase the Throttle setting.\n\n"
"To coast\n"
"1.	Hold down the A key to reduce the Throttle to 0%.\n"
"2.	Press Shift+E to move the Speed Gear handle from 1 to Neutral.\n\n"
"To resume powered operation\n"
"1.	If traveling under 50 km/h, press E once to move the Speed Gear handle to 1. If traveling over 50 km/h, press E twice to move the Speed Gear handle to 2.\n"
"To move forward\n"
"1.	Press Shift+E if necessary to move the Speed Gear handle to neutral.\n"
"2. Hold down the A key as necessary to move the Throttle to 0%.\n"
"3.	Press the W key to move the Reverser to Forward.\n"
"4. Press E to move the Speed Gear handle to 1.\n"
"5.	Hold down the ; (SEMICOLON) key to release the train brakes.\n"
"6.	Press the D key to move increase the Throttle setting.\n\n"
"To coast\n"
"1.	Hold down the A key to reduce the Throttle to 0%.\n"
"2.	Press Shift+E to move the Speed Gear handle from 1 to Neutral.\n\n"
"To resume powered operation\n"
"1.	If traveling under 50 km/h, press E once to move the Speed Gear handle to 1. If traveling over 50 km/h, press E twice to move the Speed Gear handle to 2.\n"
"To move forward\n"
"1.	Press the W key several times to move the Reverser to full Forward.\n"
"2.	Press the ; (SEMICOLON) key to release the train brakes.\n"
"3.	Press the D key to increase the Regulator setting.\n"
"4.	As you accelerate, press the S key to slowly reduce the Reverser setting, then adjust the Regulator to maintain the desired speed.\n\n"
"To slow the train\n"
"1.	Press the A key to move the Regulator to a lower setting.\n"
"2.	Use the brakes to further reduce speed if desired.\n\n"
"To apply the train brakes\n"
"1.	Press the ' (APOSTROPHE) key to apply the train brakes.\n"
"2. To hold the brakes at their current setting, lower the brake lever until it's in its middle (Neutral) position, by pressing the ; (SEMICOLON) key.\n\n"
"To release the train brakes\n"
"To move forward\n"
"1.	Press the W key to move the Reverser to Neutral (if it is not there already) and then to Forward.\n"
"2.	Press the ; (SEMICOLON) key to release the train air brakes.\n"
"3.	Press the [ (LEFT BRACKET) key to release the locomotive brakes.\n"
"4.	Press the D key to move the throttle from Idle to Notch 1. The load meter will immediately show the load increase. Your train may start moving at once.\n"
"5.	Gradually increase power every few seconds, one notch at a time, until your train reaches the desired speed.\n\n"
"To slow the train\n"
"1.	Press the A key to move the throttle to a lower setting.\n"
"2.	Use the train brakes or the dynamic brakes to further reduce speed if desired.\n\n"
"To apply the dynamic brakes\n"
"1.	After making sure the Reverser is set for the direction in which the locomotive is moving (Forward or Reverse), press the A key to return the throttle to the Idle position. Wait 10 seconds.\n"
"2.	Press the . (PERIOD) key to advance the Dynamic Brake handle to the Setup position.\n"
"To move forward\n"
"1. 	The pantograph has been raised for you. (If it is not up for some reason, press the P key to raise it.)\n"
"2.	Press the W key to move the Reverser to Forward.\n"
"3.	Press the ; (SEMICOLON) key to release the train brakes.\n"
"4.	Press the D key to move the throttle from Idle to Notch 1.\n"
"5.	Gradually increase power (D key), one notch at a time, until your train reaches the desired speed.\n\n"
"To slow the train\n"
"1.	Press the A key to move the throttle to a lower setting.\n"
"2.	Use the brakes to further reduce speed if desired.\n\n"
"To apply the train brakes\n"
"1.	Press the ' (APOSTROPHE) key to apply the train brakes.\n\n"
"To release the train brakes\n"
"To move forward\n"
"1. 	The pantograph has been raised for you. (If it is not up for some reason, press the P key to raise it.)\n"
"2.	Press the D key to move the master control lever into the Idle position.\n"
"	Note: A green lamp lights when the master control lever is in the Idle position.\n"
"3.	Press the W key to move the Reverser handle to Forward.\n"
"	Note: The Reverser can be operated only when the master control lever is in the Idle position.\n"
"4.	Press the D key to move the master control lever to throttle notch 1.\n"
"5.	If more power or speed is needed, press the D key to move the master control lever to higher throttle notch settings.\n\n"
"To slow the train\n"
"1.	Press the A key to move the throttle to a lower setting.\n"
"2.	Use the brakes to further reduce speed if desired.\n\n"
"To apply the train brakes\n"
